faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar XE D165 use?
faqLeft.a: The XE D165 uses the Ingenium AJ200D - a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel. It was fitted from 2015 until diesel was dropped from the UK and NA range around 2020.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar XE D165 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,000. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my XE D165?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm you have the AJ200D Ingenium diesel engine before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ200D Jaguar XE D165 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace the timing chain, injectors, EGR and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used XE D165 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my XE D165 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an XE D165 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most XE D165 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
